stem:
Harsh finds small iron nails mixed with sawdust and wants a quick clean-up without picking each nail by hand.

Which method is suitable?

options.text: Use a magnet to pull out the iron nails.
Use a magnet to pull out aluminium scraps mixed the same way.
Use a magnet on a pile of only iron nails and scrap iron to sort them from each other.
Avoid the magnet for tiny iron bits; magnetic separation needs pieces large enough to pick by hand.

teacher.key_rationale: Iron is magnetic and sawdust is not, so a magnet separates them.
